###  Spatially Corrected Rep-wise Yield Correlation (SCRYC)
 - correlation of phenotypes/yield after removing spatial effects across reps
- PEE much better cz autoreg.is not capturing
```{r  Spatially Corrected Yiled, yld6, 04272026}
# ============================================================
# NEW METRIC: SPATIALLY CORRECTED YIELD (yld6_et23)
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------
# 1. PREPARE WORKING DATA
# -------------------------------
nmsu23_et_pheno_SC <- nmsu23_et_pheno

# ============================================================
# 1.1 SPATIAL (AR1): EXTRACT + ALIGN SPATIAL BLUPS
# ============================================================

# Extract all random effects
spa_blup_yld6_et23 <- uni_nmsu23_et_yld6_spa$coefficients$random
spa_blup_yld6_et23
# Extract ONLY Row:Range spatial effects (correct pattern)
spa_eff_yld6_et23 <- spa_blup_yld6_et23[
  grep("^Row_[0-9]+:Range_[0-9]+", rownames(spa_blup_yld6_et23)),
  , drop = FALSE]
spa_eff_yld6_et23

# Build lookup table (use column name "effect")
spa_df_yld6_et23 <- data.frame(
  RowRange = rownames(spa_eff_yld6_et23),
  spa_eff_yld6_et23 = spa_eff_yld6_et23[,"effect"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
spa_df_yld6_et23
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create matching key in phenotype data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$RowRange <- paste0(
  "Row_", nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$Row,
  ":Range_", nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$Range)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Match WITHOUT reordering (IMPORTANT)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

match_idx <- match(
  nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$RowRange,
  spa_df_yld6_et23$RowRange)

nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$spa_eff_yld6_et23 <- 
  spa_df_yld6_et23$spa_eff_yld6_et23[match_idx]
 # i doubled check the spatial blups and these columns to make sure i am getting what i wanted

# Sanity check (must be zero)
sum(is.na(nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$spa_eff_yld6_et23)) # 0

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Corrected yield (AR1)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$yld6_spa_corr_et23 <- 
  nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$yld6 - nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$spa_eff_yld6_et23




# ============================================================
# 1.2 PEE: DIRECT SPATIAL CORRECTION
# ============================================================

 # we need to scale PEE to be able to use it for spatial correction

# lets see
# Extract coefficient
beta_pee_yld6_et23 <- uni_nmsu23_et_yld6_pee$coefficients$fixed["PEE_311", "effect"]
beta_pee_yld6_et23   #  

# Apply correct spatial correction
nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$yld6_pee_corr_et23 <- 
  nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$yld6 - 
  beta_pee_yld6_et23 * nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$PEE_311


# ============================================================
# 2. REP-WISE CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------
# SPLIT DATA BY REP
# -------------------------------

rep1_yld6_et23 <- nmsu23_et_pheno_SC[nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$Rep == 1, ]
dim(nmsu23_et_pheno_SC) # 144*69
dim(rep1_yld6_et23) # should be 144/4 = 36 and it is. JUST SANITY CHECK
rep2_yld6_et23 <- nmsu23_et_pheno_SC[nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$Rep == 2, ]
rep3_yld6_et23 <- nmsu23_et_pheno_SC[nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$Rep == 3, ]
rep4_yld6_et23 <- nmsu23_et_pheno_SC[nmsu23_et_pheno_SC$Rep == 4, ]

# Align by genotype
rep1_yld6_et23 <- rep1_yld6_et23[order(rep1_yld6_et23$Germplasm), ]
rep2_yld6_et23 <- rep2_yld6_et23[order(rep2_yld6_et23$Germplasm), ]
rep3_yld6_et23 <- rep3_yld6_et23[order(rep3_yld6_et23$Germplasm), ]
rep4_yld6_et23 <- rep4_yld6_et23[order(rep4_yld6_et23$Germplasm), ]


# ============================================================
# 1. RAW YIELD
# ============================================================

cor_raw_yld6_et23 <- c(
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6, rep2_yld6_et23$yld6, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6, rep3_yld6_et23$yld6, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep2_yld6_et23$yld6, rep3_yld6_et23$yld6, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep2_yld6_et23$yld6, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep3_yld6_et23$yld6, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6, use="complete.obs") )

df_raw_yld6_et23 <- data.frame(
  Model = "Raw",
  Correlation = cor_raw_yld6_et23)
df_raw_yld6_et23

# ============================================================
# 2. AR1 CORRECTED
# ============================================================

cor_spa_cor_yld6_et23 <- c(
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, rep2_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, rep3_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep2_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, rep3_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep2_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep3_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6_spa_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"))

df_spa_yld6_et23 <- data.frame(
  Model = "Spa(AR1)",
  Correlation = cor_spa_cor_yld6_et23)
df_spa_yld6_et23

# ============================================================
# 3. PEE CORRECTED
# ============================================================

cor_pee_cor_yld6_et23 <- c(
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, rep2_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, rep3_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep1_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep2_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, rep3_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep2_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"),
  cor(rep3_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, rep4_yld6_et23$yld6_pee_corr_et23, use="complete.obs"))

df_pee_yld6_et23 <- data.frame(
  Model = "PEE",
  Correlation = cor_pee_cor_yld6_et23)
df_pee_yld6_et23

# ============================================================
# 4. COMBINE + PLOT
# ============================================================

df_all_yld6_et23 <- rbind(
  df_raw_yld6_et23,
  df_spa_yld6_et23,
  df_pee_yld6_et23)

df_all_yld6_et23$Model <- factor(
  df_all_yld6_et23$Model,
  levels = c("Raw", "Spa(AR1)", "PEE"))

boxplot(
  Correlation ~ Model,
  data = df_all_yld6_et23,
  col = c("lightgray", "lightblue", "lightgreen"),
  ylab = "Rep-to-rep correlation",
  main = "ET23 yld6: Spatial Correction Comparison",
  ylim = c(0,1)
)

# Summary
aggregate(Correlation ~ Model, df_all_yld6_et23, mean)
aggregate(Correlation ~ Model, df_all_yld6_et23, sd)
```

# Metrics as Baseline deviation (for cor, GEER, validation of GEER:
## 1. Metrics as Baseline deviation: ΔGEER 

GEER as deviation, ΔGEER
yld2
- in each rep, we do the subtraction
```{r yld2, GEER deviation, ET23, 04292026}
## ============================================================
## yld2: Compute GEER deviation (ΔGEER) relative to baseline
## et23
## ============================================================

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 1: Inspect input GEER results
## ------------------------------------------------------------
GEER_results_yld2_et23


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 2: Convert to wide format
## Each row = replicate pair
## Columns = Base, Spa(AR), PEE
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df_wide_yld2_et23 <- GEER_results_yld2_et23 %>%
  dplyr::select(Rep1, Rep2, Model, Pearson) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Pearson)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 3: Compute deviation from baseline (ΔGEER)
## AR  = Spa(AR) − Base
## RR  = PEE − Base
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df_delta_yld2_et23 <- df_wide_yld2_et23 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    AR = `Spa(AR)` - Base,
    RR = PEE - Base)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 4: Convert to long format for plotting
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df_plot_yld2_et23 <- df_delta_yld2_et23 %>%
  dplyr::select(Rep1, Rep2, AR, RR) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AR, RR),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Delta")


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 5: Ensure consistent model order
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df_plot_yld2_et23$Model <- factor(
  df_plot_yld2_et23$Model,
  levels = c("AR", "RR"))


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 6: Boxplot of ΔGEER
## ------------------------------------------------------------
boxplot(
  Delta ~ Model,
  data = df_plot_yld2_et23,
  col = c("skyblue", "tomato"),
  boxwex = 0.3,  # default ≈ 0.8 → reduce this
  ylab = expression(Delta~GEER),
  main = "yld2: Improvement over Baseline (ΔGEER)")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)


```

## 2. Deviation based for cor: ΔCOR → correlation(fitted, observed) 

```{r ΔCOR et23, 04292026}
## ============================================================
## ΔCOR: Fit vs Observed correlation (relative to Base)
## et23
## ============================================================

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 1: Create table manually (per yield)
## ------------------------------------------------------------

cor_et23 <- data.frame(
  Harvest = paste0("YLD", 2:6), # yld starts from 2 here
  Base = c(
    cor_fit_obs_base_yld2_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_base_yld3_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_base_yld4_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_base_yld5_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_base_yld6_et23),
  AR = c(
    cor_fit_obs_spa_yld2_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_spa_yld3_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_spa_yld4_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_spa_yld5_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_spa_yld6_et23),
  RR = c(
    cor_fit_obs_pee_yld2_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_pee_yld3_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_pee_yld4_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_pee_yld5_et23,
    cor_fit_obs_pee_yld6_et23))

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 2: Compute ΔCOR
## ------------------------------------------------------------
cor_delta_et23 <- cor_et23 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    AR = AR - Base, # here AR-base
    RR = RR - Base) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AR, RR),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Delta")

cor_delta_et23$Model <- factor(cor_delta_et23$Model, levels = c("AR","RR"))


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 3: Plot
## ------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(cor_delta_et23, aes(Model, Delta, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.05, size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab(expression(Delta~COR)) +
  ggtitle("et23: All Harvests- Fitted vs Observed Yields (ΔCOR)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r VAL: Validation of GEER (AR, RR vs Base GBLUP), et23, 04292026 }
  Harvest = "YLD4",
  Rep = 1:4,
  Base = c(0.74,	0.69,	0.80,	0.86), # from above chunks saved in excel and grabbed from there
  AR = c(0.48, 0.84, 0.82, 0.87),
  RR = c(0.79, 0.94, 0.87, 0.92)
)

## YLD5
val_yld5_et23 <- data.frame(
  Harvest = "YLD5",
  Rep = 1:4,
  Base = c(0.74,	0.83,	0.88,	0.85), # from above chunks saved in excel and grabbed from there
  AR = c(0.76, 0.83, 0.82, 0.86),
  RR = c(0.99, 0.99, 0.99, 0.99)
)

## YLD6
val_yld6_et23 <- data.frame(
  Harvest = "YLD6",
  Rep = 1:4,
  Base = c(0.94,	0.93,	0.82,	0.95), # from above chunks saved in excel and grabbed from there
  AR = c(0.83, 0.93, 0.90, 0.96),
  RR = c(0.88, 0.92, 0.94, 0.96)
)



## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 2: Combine all yields
## ------------------------------------------------------------
val_all_et23 <- rbind(val_yld2_et23, val_yld3_et23, val_yld4_et23, val_yld5_et23, val_yld6_et23)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 3: Convert to long format
## ------------------------------------------------------------
val_long_et23 <- val_all_et23 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Base, AR, RR),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Value")


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 4: Ensure consistent ordering
## ------------------------------------------------------------
val_long_et23$Model <- factor(
  val_long_et23$Model,
  levels = c("Base", "AR", "RR"))

# export this file
write.csv(val_long_et23, file = "2023/MSI_data/output_files/valGEER_ET23_NMSU.csv", col.names = TRUE)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 5: Plot validation correlations
## ------------------------------------------------------------

gg_val_long_et23 <- ggplot(val_long_et23, aes(x = Model, y = Value,fill = Model)) + # !!
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.9,outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "ET23 All Harvests: Validation GEER with base GBLUP", # !!
    x = "Model",
    y = "Validation GEER (correlation)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Base" = "gray",
      "AR" = "lightblue",
      "RR" = "lightgreen")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right")
gg_val_long_et23

ggsave(filename = "ValGEER_boxplots_Early_Termination_2023_NMSU.png", plot = gg_val_long_et23, path = "2023/output_images", width = 10, height = 10,dpi = 400)
```


Also lets do deviation for spatial:


```{r ΔSCRYC, All harvests, ET23, 04292026}
## ============================================================
## ALL HARVESTS: ΔSC (relative to Raw)
## et23

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 1: Reconstruct pair structure within each harvest
## (6 replicate-pairs per harvest)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
SC_delta_et23 <- SC_all_et23 %>%
  group_by(Harvest) %>%
  mutate(Pair = rep(1:6, times = 3)) %>%   # Raw, AR, PEE each have 6
  ungroup()


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 2: Convert to wide format (align per pair)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
SC_delta_et23 <- SC_delta_et23 %>%
  dplyr::select(Harvest, Pair, Model, Correlation) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Correlation)

SC_delta_et23


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 3: Compute ΔSC
## ------------------------------------------------------------
SC_delta_et23 <- SC_delta_et23 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    AR = `Spa(AR1)` - Raw,
    RR = PEE - Raw
  )


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 4: Convert to long format
## ------------------------------------------------------------
SC_delta_et23 <- SC_delta_et23 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AR, RR),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Delta"
  )


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 5: Ensure consistent ordering
## ------------------------------------------------------------
SC_delta_et23$Model <- factor(
  SC_delta_et23$Model,
  levels = c("AR", "RR")
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 6: Plot ΔSC across all harvests
## ------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(SC_delta_et23, aes(x = Model, y = Delta, fill = Model)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.20, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 3,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-0.2, 0.6, by = 0.1)
  ) +
  
  ylab(expression(Delta~SC)) +
  
  ggtitle("ET23 All Harvests: Spatial Correction Improvement (ΔSC)") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
